title: The involvement of the human prefrontal cortex in the emergence of visual awareness (Fang et al., 2024): sEEG, 6 patients
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from six adult male patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a visual awareness task with saccadic report. Near-threshold Gabor gratings were presented while patients reported perception via saccade direction, enabling study of prefrontal cortex involvement in the emergence of visual awareness. The dataset includes per-trial behaviour, defaced T1 MRI, and source data with post-implantation CT and eye-position/behaviour files from patients and 10 healthy controls.
methods_description: Depth electrodes (SINOVATION, 8-20 contacts) were recorded with a NEURACLE amplifier at 1 kHz (1-250 Hz hardware filter, 50 Hz notch) against a white-matter contact reference, with 108-254 channels per recording. Patients performed a visual awareness task with a 50 ms Gabor grating at threshold contrast (1 up/1 down staircase) followed by a color-cued saccade report, with eye position tracked by an infrared eye tracker at 1 kHz. Original BDF data were converted to BrainVision format with exact digital values preserved.
